Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient description provides no evidence of HIV infection.
Written informed consent has been obtained from the patient or their legal representative.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Reasonably good health at time of study entry.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has complex cardiac history, diabetes, and mild hepatic elevation, but no explicit assessment of overall health status.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Perceived life expectancy of at least six months.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has advanced coronary artery disease and ischemic cardiomyopathy, but life expectancy is not explicitly documented.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Allowed: Participation in other clinical trials as long as there is no potential activity of other study drugs against Mycobacterium tuberculosis (MTb), additive toxicities between study agents, or known possible drug interactions between study drugs.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient is not on antituberculous agents or drugs with potential antituberculous activity.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Prior Medication: Allowed: - Treatment with quinolones, fluoroquinolones, aminoglycosides, or other agents with known or potential activity against M. tuberculosis.
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient is not on any antituberculous agents or drugs with potential antituberculous activity.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No evidence of tuberculosis in patient description.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Sensitivity or intolerance to study medication.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No data on medication sensitivities or intolerances.
Mild hepatic transaminase elevation is suspected to be secondary to statin therapy or non-alcoholic fatty liver disease, not acute hepatitis.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Evidence of peripheral neuropathy, i.e., signs or symptoms of paresis, paresthesias, neuromotor abnormalities, or neurosensory deficits of grade 3 or worse.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No evidence of peripheral neuropathy in patient description.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Inability to have concomitant medications changed to avoid serious interaction with study drug.
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient is on atorvastatin and metformin, which are not excluded medications.

Recap: Patient does not meet HIV infection requirement (inclusion criterion) and lacks explicit documentation of life expectancy or health status. No exclusion criteria are violated.
